snippet.title: Roots: Building Project Motor Racing - Supercut
snippet.description: How you do one thing is how you do everything. Watch as S4 recreate the beast that is the Lister Storm GT. S4’s Principal Env. Artist, Jan Pavelko, meanwhile, should have had a bigger lunch when @BenCollinsDrives  took him out to explore Silverstone!
